title: Cicada 3301 Research Archive and Liber Primus Cryptanalysis
description: A documented, falsifiable investigation of the Cicada 3301 puzzles and a validated pure-Python cryptanalysis rig aimed at the unsolved Liber Primus pages (LP2 0-54, 12,956 runes). The central result is a negative with a precisely stated scope: the unsolved pages are OTP-class, meaning the ciphertext cannot be distinguished between a true external one-time pad (information-theoretically closed) and a keystream derived from a short seed (a finite, brute-forceable keyspace); which of those it is remains unsettled. The repository's methodological contribution is a discipline for producing negative results that are worth something: every attack is pre-registered with its threshold fixed in advance, every instrument must first recover a planted signal before its silence is trusted, and every null is size-matched and corrected for the number of trials run. It ships that discipline as a reusable benchmark, a machine-readable falsification ledger, and an oracle that adjudicates candidate solutions against criteria committed to in advance. It also records its own corrections, including an overstated headline verdict and two measurement errors in its own instruments.
